title: Rust fragmentation policy never reclaims retired peer slots
description: FragmentationPolicy installs only into an existing signer or empty slot and exposes no retire/remove lifecycle. After MAX_PEERS distinct signers have ever been accepted, later authenticated peers fail PolicyFull forever even if Link/PeerContextAuthority retired all old peers. Wire atomic peer retirement/eviction into policy, invalidate sessions/tombstones safely, and add churn/current-session/slot-reuse tests.
